testedScope: 0.4.0 native bridge. Bounded candidate technical acceptance was completed for the specified models and environment; exact release-commit CI and rebuilt package acceptance are verified separately by the publication pipeline. The bundled 87408-byte ABI2 bridge and its five source identities are unchanged. Earlier remaining-2308 evidence covers dynamic binding/failure recovery and the smoke harness boundary fix without a bridge rebuild. 2026-11-11 actual official 0.3.0 and candidate nupkg consumers, on the same RKNN Runtime 2.3.2/RGA 1.10.1_[3], passed the specified static V5/V8n bus fixture: all 3/9 output-head hashes and letterbox transforms match across versions, each Raw/Into pair is byte-identical, detections are 4 persons and 1 bus. Twelve measured processes produced 3600 samples with no consistent performance regression. Candidate actual-package dynamic probability-model verification passed 640/480/320 with pools 1/3, Raw/Into, 180 concurrent all-head/input-output-metadata/transform comparisons against independent shape snapshots, rejected512/recovered640 and five pool3 create/dispose cycles. Probability outputs use RawTensor plus explicit application decoding; product V5 raw-logits defaults remain unchanged. The same candidate V8n process completed 34598 valid Predict calls over 590.0012151 seconds and exited 0 without restart. DMA descriptors return to fixture-only after pipeline Dispose and zero after fixture Dispose. Two device descriptors for /dev/dri/card0 and /dev/rga remain until process exit, matching official 0.3.0 in the same phases and not accumulating over the finite dynamic cycles; their exact owning layer is not uniquely established, so no all-native-resources-zero or proven-no-leak claim is made. External steady RSS ranged 80004-88040 KiB without forced GC. Independent post-exit checks confirmed release of this task occupancy; this bounded run does not establish long-duration stability. RGA centered-improcess/content-improcess/imresize natural and synthetic fixture paths are byte-identical; relative ideal-half-pixel differences remain, and the exact vendor pixel mathematics are not matched. These finite same-runtime package and geometry results reveal no added packaging/version regression; ideal-reference differences alone do not establish a new product defect or prove arbitrary resize accuracy. Dataset mAP lacks independent GT; arbitrary models/BSPs and long-duration stability are unverified. Evidence: .artifacts/session-pool-20261110/remaining-2308/final-acceptance and dynamic-semantics/rga-followup/three-paths. Native build sources remain identified by their exact byte/LF hashes; package source commit and publication status are verified separately.
sourceIdentity: sources records exact tested working-tree byte SHA256; sourceRepositoryLfSha256 records the same source after Git CRLF-to-LF normalization. The tested source was not a clean release commit.
packPolicy: Default pack checks the bundled binary SHA256. An explicit RKNNSharpNativeLibraryPath bypasses that bundled hash check; the caller must verify its own build and ABI. Rebuilding instructions: docs/hardware.md.
